content_sections.heading: CSIR-NAL Vacancy 2026 – Post & Specialization-Wise Details
content_sections.text: CSIR-NAL Vacancy 2026 spans multiple engineering and science specializations, each with its own Walk-in-Interview date. Candidates should check the specialization and date relevant to their qualification. The notification states these position numbers may vary as per project requirements, and CSIR-NAL will form a panel of waitlisted candidates to support new projects - valid for one year from the date of notification of result, or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier.

rows.post: Principal PAT (emoluments not specified in the notification)

content_sections.heading: CSIR-NAL Eligibility Criteria & Qualification 2026
content_sections.text: Eligibility depends on the post level and the specialization applied for. General essential qualification for each post category is summarized below; the exact discipline (e.g. Mechanical, Electronics, Chemistry) must match the specialization listed in the Vacancy table for the post code applied to. Only candidates who have already completed their qualifying degree/diploma are eligible - candidates awaiting results of a qualifying examination cannot attend the interview. Where a candidate claims an equivalent qualification, they must produce the order/letter (with number and date) recognizing the equivalence, failing which the application is liable to be rejected. The prescribed qualifications are the minimum required; CSIR-NAL applies its own criteria for shortlisting and possessing the minimum qualification alone does not guarantee an interview call.

rows.essential_qualification_general_pattern: SSC/10th plus ITI in Fitter trade

Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology (or, for some specializations, Master's/Integrated Master's) from a recognized University, or an equivalent qualification recognized by the competent authority as per project requirement, recorded in writing by the PI and Director
Same as PAT-I above, with a valid NET/GATE qualification
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology (or equivalent) with 2 years' relevant R&D experience, OR Master's/Integrated Master's in Engineering or Technology
Same as PAT-II above, with a valid NET/GATE qualification (some specializations also accept Master's in Science)

Bachelor's degree in the relevant Engineering/Technology discipline with 3 years' relevant R&D experience, OR Master's/Integrated Master's in the relevant discipline with 2 years' relevant R&D experience
BE/B.Tech with 3 years' experience, OR ME/M.Tech with a valid NET/GATE, OR Ph.D., in the relevant discipline

content_sections.heading: CSIR-NAL Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is 35 years for all posts under this notification, assessed as on the date of the Walk-in-Interview for the relevant post. Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates (or as per Government of India instructions issued from time to time). Candidates must clearly mention their category and attach documentary proof; without this proof, age relaxation will not be entertained and the candidate will not be permitted to appear for interview. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-NAL Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is based on performance in the interview, or any other criteria adopted by the Selection Committee. If a large number of candidates appear, the Selection/Screening Committee has the discretion to shortlist candidates through a written exam or any other criteria it deems fit before the interview. A panel of suitable candidates is drawn up after the selection process, valid for a maximum of one year; empanelment does not automatically guarantee engagement, and utilization depends on the number of positions available across projects during that period.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-NAL Recruitment 2026 (Walk-in-Interview Process)
content_sections.text: CSIR-NAL Recruitment 2026 has no apply-online option, and applications sent by post, speed post, or e-mail are explicitly not accepted. Download the prescribed Application Form for Walk-in-Interview (Advt. No. 13/2026/PS) from the CSIR-NAL website and fill it completely. Report in person at CSIR-NAL (RAB Meeting Complex, National Aerospace Laboratories), Adjacent to SBI NAL Branch, Kodihalli, Bengaluru – 560017, between 9:00 AM and 9:45 AM on the date fixed for the post/specialization you are applying for. Bring a copy of your Aadhaar Card or another Government-issued photo ID, the duly filled application form, a latest passport-size photograph, and original certificates along with one set of photocopies (including Caste Certificate, if applicable, in the proper format). Candidates wishing to apply for more than one position must apply separately for each position. Be prepared to return the next day if your interview is not completed on the scheduled date for any reason. No TA/DA is paid for attending the Walk-in-Interview. Candidates already working in CSIR-NAL or any other CSIR lab must bring a "No Objection Certificate" from their Project Leader/HOD at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-NAL Documents Required 2026
content_sections.text: Duly filled-in Application Form for Walk-in-Interview (from the CSIR-NAL website) Aadhaar Card or other Government-issued photo ID Latest passport-size photograph Original Educational Qualification certificates with all mark sheets, plus one set of photocopies Experience certificates (where applicable), plus photocopies Caste Certificate in the proper format (for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD candidates claiming reservation/age relaxation), plus photocopy Valid NET/GATE score card/certificate (for posts requiring it) No Objection Certificate from Project Leader/HOD (only if already working in CSIR-NAL/CSIR)

faq.question: Q1. What is CSIR-NAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a Walk-in-Interview recruitment drive by CSIR-National Aerospace Laboratories, Bengaluru (Advt. No. 13/2026/PS, published 05.08.2026), to engage Project Staff — Project Assistant, Project Associate, Senior PAT, and Principal PAT - on a temporary, project basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSIR-NAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Adding the position-wise numbers across all specializations gives approximately 89 posts. This is a computed figure; the notification does not state a single combined total, and positions may vary as per project requirements.

faq.question: Q3. Is there a last date to apply for CSIR-NAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no last date in the usual sense, since this is a walk-in process. Interviews are held on specific dates between 10 August 2026 and 24/25 August 2026, depending on the post and specialization — see the Important Dates table above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for CSIR-NAL Project Staff posts?
faq.answer: It ranges from SSC/10th plus ITI (Project Assistant-I) and Diploma in Engineering (Project Assistant-II) to Bachelor's/Master's/Integrated Master's degrees in Engineering, Technology, or Science, and Ph.D. for some Principal PAT positions. Exact qualification depends on the specialization and post - see the Eligibility Criteria table.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSIR-NAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years for all posts, as on the date of the Walk-in-Interview. Age relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST/PwBD/Women and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for CSIR-NAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for CSIR-NAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online application. Candidates must attend the Walk-in-Interview in person at CSIR-NAL, Kodihalli, Bengaluru, on the date assigned to their post/specialization, with the filled application form and required documents. Applications by post, speed post, or e-mail are not accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CSIR-NAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on performance in the interview, or other criteria set by the Selection Committee. If candidate numbers are high, a written exam or other shortlisting method may be used before the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for CSIR-NAL Project Staff posts?
faq.answer: Monthly emoluments range from ₹18,000 + HRA (Project Assistant-I) up to ₹42,000 + HRA (Senior PAT); Principal PAT emoluments are not specified in the notification. Full post-wise salary is given in the Salary table above.

faq.question: Q10. Do CSIR-NAL Project Staff positions lead to permanent employment?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary and on contract basis, confers no right to continuation, absorption, or regularization in CSIR, and can be terminated by either side with one month's notice or one month's stipend in lieu. Maximum tenure across CSIR-NAL/CSIR labs, taken together, cannot exceed six years.
